# easy2share

## Overview

easy2share is a secure local clipboard and file-sharing app for transferring text and files from a mobile device to an another device via browser without accounts, cloud storage, or a relay service.

## How it works

1. Open the easy2share mobile app on your phone.
2. Visit https://getsharing.link in a browser on the desktop or another trusted device.
3. Generate a secure session key and display the QR code.
4. Scan the QR code with the mobile app.
5. Accept the encrypted connection and then share clipboard text or files directly between the devices.

## Security model

- Direct device-to-device connection over a local network.
- Fresh session key generated for each connection.
- QR handoff transfers the session key without sending it over the internet.
- Data is protected with authenticated encryption (ChaCha20-Poly1305).

## Privacy

The web client and mobile app do not collect or store personal data for clipboard or file transfers. The official web app is hosted at https://getsharing.link and the privacy policy is at https://getsharing.link/privacy-policy.

## Official links

- Website: https://getsharing.link/
- Privacy policy: https://getsharing.link/privacy-policy
- GitHub: https://github.com/marek-szanyi/easy2share
